svg.font-family: Fredoka, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: Level 5: Spring Step · NEW: SPRING · par 7 · Red first · 1800×720
red parks on DOOR: the door opens
SPRING (150,-800): every pad x rests on TOP
TOP holds the DOOR from above
Level 6: Booby Trap · NEW: TRAP · par 7 · Red first · 1700×720
lob LEFT onto the PERCH: holds the DOOR
FREE, FAR or the cup opens the TRAP
FAR holds the DOOR; cup holds FAR
Level 7: Load & Fire · NEW: CANNON · par 8 · Red first · 1960×720
lob into the funnel: LOADED (waits) or BOOM if lit
lands on the far FIRE plate; cup holds it
chasm: +1, back to the safe spot
Level 8: Colour Lift · World 2 exam (nothing new) · par 8 · Blue first · 1960×720
blue passes its own field; red needs the WINDOW
blue bounces off the red field onto the WINDOW plate
red flies through onto the DOOR plate; cup holds DOOR
Level 9: Bait · trap + spring + door · par 9 · Red first · 1960×720
BAIT plate sits in a TRAP and holds the DOOR
raised mouth: lob in, SPRING to TOP
TOP frees the bait and holds the DOOR; cup holds TOP
Level 10: Sky Bridge · cannon + spring + bridge · par 7 · Blue first · 1960×720
BRIDGE (while A / B / DECK is held)
cold cannon: a ball waits here LOADED
A, B or DECK hold the BRIDGE and light the CANNON
cannon lands on B; cup holds B
Level 11: Crossfire · colour fields + cannon + door · par 8 · Red first · 1960×720
FIRE: blue only (behind the blue field)
red only: lob through the red field into the cannon
FAR opens the DOOR and keeps the cannon lit; cup holds FAR
Level 12: Grand Machine · finale: cannon + spring + trap + door · par 8 · Red first · 1960×720
pit TRAP: FIRE or TOP frees it
FLY: lob LEFT into the cannon
DOOR plate sits in a TRAP (seat)
TOP: door, cannon, both traps; cup holds TOP
